task: downstream-svc keeps crashing and taking order-svc down with it. Add failure protection so order-svc survives downstream failures.

candidate_memories.content: order-svc must wrap its downstream-svc HTTP client with a circuit breaker (go-hystrix); open threshold is 5 failures in 10 s.
When a downstream dependency is unreliable, wrap it with a circuit breaker before any other resilience measure; this prevents cascade failures.
Circuit breaker fallback for downstream-svc calls should return a cached result or a graceful degraded response, not an error to the caller.
TLS certificate on downstream-svc expires in 14 days; renew before it causes connection failures.
candidate_memories.notes: note: failure cause is reliability, not certs

candidate_memories.content: Retrying failed requests with exponential backoff reduces transient failure impact but does not protect against sustained downstream outages.
candidate_memories.notes: note: retry ≠ circuit breaker, different mechanism

candidate_memories.content: downstream-svc team is investigating a memory leak; ETA for fix is 48 h.
